_README: android-managed-config.json — SAMPLE Android Enterprise managed-configuration document.
HOW TO USE (Intune → Apps → App configuration policies → Create → Managed devices →
Platform = Android Enterprise → Targeted app = your managed Google Play app):
* PREFER the Configuration designer. On Android you do NOT type key names — Intune reads the
app's managed-configuration SCHEMA from managed Google Play and renders each key. Fill in
values there. Keys the app did not publish cannot be set.
* Use raw JSON (this format) only when you must supply a whole managed-configuration document
(e.g. an OEMConfig-style bundle). Map each value to the schema's exact key.
KEY NAMES ARE SCHEMA-DEFINED by the app vendor — the keys below are PLACEHOLDERS. Confirm them
in the app's managed-configuration schema (shown in the Intune designer) / vendor docs.
HOSTNAME, NOT URL: server_host is a bare hostname — no https://, no path/slash.
